title: Petra and the Vow
author: Xanthe Iversen
blurb: Bram Blackwood, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
